svg.title: Rabin: a Lorenz attractor drawn by two nearly identical trajectories
svg.desc: A dark graph-paper panel. The name Rabin sits at left above three equations: the Schrodinger equation, gradient descent and Euler's identity. At right two trajectories of the Lorenz system, one cyan and one amber, start 0.001 apart and slowly diverge.
svg.text: // rabin.sim — phase space of one curious mind
